text:
Palladium Price in 2020
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2020, the LBMA palladium price rose 2.0% between 2020-01-31 ($2,295) and 2020-12-30 ($2,342). The highest sampled price was $2,719 in February and the lowest was $1,905 in June. The mean of these observations was $2,223. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2020:
COVID-19 and unprecedented monetary stimulus pushed gold above $2,000 per ounce for the first time.
